combo.description: Use E then mid animation Flash to the other side of your opponent so that they get pushed into a wall, then AA Q AA AA.
When going all in R then instantly Q. Open with an AA then quickly E your target into a wall, then continue to AA in between your Q cooldown time.
Condemn can also be used to escape. AA then quickly Q AA. E and then Flash immediately right after.
When going aggressive AA, E your target into a wall, Q towards your target and then AA.
Stun your target by using E into a wall then AA. Q away from them and continue to AA as you retreat.
To poke trade AA then instantly Q AA and E your target away.
Trade normally with AA then quickly Q, AA and AA again.
AA then instantly Q into a wall and AA as quickly as possible.
